description: This file defines the PythonWorker class and the PythonWorkerFactory class, which manages the creation, connection, and lifecycle of Python worker processes in Apache Spark, including support for daemonized workers and socket communication.

classes.name: PythonWorker
classes.description: Represents a Python worker process with socket communication, capable of refreshing its selector and stopping itself.

classes.name: PythonWorkerFactory
classes.description: Factory class responsible for creating, managing, and terminating Python worker processes, supporting both daemonized and direct execution modes.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new Python worker, either through a daemon or directly, depending on configuration.

methods.name: createThroughDaemon
methods.description: Connects to a worker launched via the Python daemon, establishing socket communication.

methods.name: createSimpleWorker
methods.description: Launches a Python worker process directly by executing the worker module.

methods.name: startDaemon
methods.description: Starts the Python daemon process if not already running.

methods.name: stopDaemon
methods.description: Stops the Python daemon process if running.

methods.name: stopWorker
methods.description: Stops a specific Python worker process.

methods.name: releaseWorker
methods.description: Returns a worker to the idle pool or stops it if the pool is full.

methods.name: isWorkerStopped
methods.description: Checks if a worker process has stopped; only supported in non-daemon mode.
